relationships.subject: DNMT3a
relationships.evidence_quote: In the DRG, DNMT3a directly inhibits the expression of the Kv1.2 channels by methylation at the promoter region of the Kv1.2 gene.

relationships.subject: DNMT3a
relationships.evidence_quote: DNMT3a upregulation led to increased DNA methylation at the promoter region of the MOP receptor gene and downregulation of MOP (and KOP) receptors in the injured DRG

relationships.subject: TET1
relationships.evidence_quote: SNL increased the levels of BDNF in the dorsal horn, and this alteration was reduced by spinal TET1 knockdown.

relationships.subject: DNMT1
relationships.evidence_quote: DNMT1 was shown to reduce Kv1.2 channel expression (but not MOP or KOP receptor levels) in the injured DRG by methylating three sites of the Kv1.2 gene.

key_findings: Review: nerve injury DNA methylation via DNMT3a/DNMT1 represses MOP receptor and Kv1.2 in DRG, reversible by TET1 or DNMT inhibitors.
Epigenetic writers/readers/erasers are candidate targets for repurposed epigenetic drugs in neuropathic pain.
